```
packages/spec/src/api/plugin-rest-api.zod.ts:898

PR #19683 corrects the same spelling at `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts:815` (`404 \`[no_draft]\`` → `404 \`NO_DRAFT\``) because triage's boundary comment named that one as part of #16245's deliverable. This one was not named and is outside that PR's surface.

⭐ **Measured, and it changes the shape of the fix:** the #16245 dev verified this describe reaches **no generated references page**. So unlike its sibling, correcting it needs no `gen:docs` run and moves no `content/docs/**` byte — it is a source-and-tarball change only. ⛔ Do not assume the sibling's regeneration step applies here; re-verify before running one.

## Level
